stories.title: Five NFL trades that make too much sense: Which teams should make deals over the next month?

stories.title: Even in loss, Skubal 'plenty good' in L.A. debut
stories.summary: Two-time Cy Young Award winner Tarik Skubal didn't have his best stuff in his Los Angeles debut, landing only 51 strikes on 85 pitches, but the Dodgers also offered little run support as they dropped a 5-1 outing to the Cubs.

stories.title: Yanks' Lombard homers in debut, joining brother
stories.summary: George Lombard Jr. became the third-youngest Yankee to homer in his first game, and he did it on a night when his little brother also went deep in his own professional debut.

stories.title: Sources: Falcons' Walker feared to have torn ACL
stories.summary: Falcons edge rusher Jalon Walker is feared to have torn his ACL, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and Steve Wyche.
